Crop health from orbit

Reading NASA satellite tiles for your field…

What this assumes
  • MODIS pixels are 250 m across, so on a small field the reading mixes in hedges, roads and neighbouring land. On fields over about 10 ha it's mostly your crop.
  • Values are read from NASA GIBS map tiles; each colour stands for an NDVI band 0.01 wide.
  • "Usual" is the average for the same time of year in the previous years shown.
  • Cloud-covered or snowy periods are left out by NASA, so some dates are missing.
  • Greenness rises with leaf cover, not yield directly; a crop ripening for harvest turns brown on purpose.
